incidentPayload.title: OIL India Safety Protocol - Zero SIF Genesis Baseline
incidentPayload.observation: Initialization of the OIL India DGMS/OSHA Compliant Tamper-Proof FixLedger knowledge base.

rcaFiveWhys: Why 1: Regulatory bodies (DGMS / OSHA) require immutable proof of engineering hazard mitigation.
Why 2: Traditional databases allow unverified row overwrites, risking liability cover-ups.
Why 3: Previous audit trails lacked cryptographic mathematical linkage between incident and fix.
Why 4: Management requires verifiable zero-trust transparency before approving rig operations.
Why 5: Core Mandate: Establish an append-only, SHA-256 tamper-proof ledger for all SIF precursors.
approvedEngineeringFix: Deploy FixLedger cryptographically sealed data lock architecture on top of MongoDB with SHA-256 payload derivation.

effectivenessAudits.auditFindings: Genesis cryptographic parameters verified across Moran and Naharkatiya field nodes.

approvedEngineeringFix: Retrofit overhead certified stainless-steel rigid rail lifeline system with dual-carabiner 3M DBI-SALA SRLs.
auditorRole: Chief General Manager (Process Safety & SIF Control)

effectivenessAudits.auditFindings: Physical site inspection confirmed dual SRLs installed on monkey board. Pull-test passed at 15 kN.

incidentPayload.title: Working at Heights � Derrick Mast Fall Hazard
incidentPayload.observation: Derrickman unhooked lanyard while shifting monkey board at 15m

rcaFiveWhys: Why 1: Derrickman unclipped safety harness lanyard while traversing monkey board at 15m elevation.
Why 2: Single lanyard setup lacked continuous 100% tie-off dual-hook configuration.
Why 3: PTW checklist did not enforce dual-carabiner SRL requirement for monkey board operations.
Why 4: Rig superintendent toolbox talk did not inspect tether certs prior to shift.
Why 5: Absence of automated interlocked overhead inertia-reel safety track along derrick beam.

incidentPayload.title: H2S Toxic Gas Alarm Loop Telemetry Bypass
incidentPayload.failedBarrier: Fixed Gas Detection Telemetry & Emergency Vent Shutdown
incidentPayload.observation: H2S sensor bypass jumper found on GGS-1 header during shift change

rcaFiveWhys: Why 1: Atmospheric H2S alarm was suppressed via physical bypass jumper.
Why 2: Nuisance trip during pipeline pigging caused operator to bypass loop.
Why 3: No Management of Change (MOC) or temporary defeat register logged.
Why 4: Supervisory audit failed to cross-check bypass status on DCS panel.
Why 5: Lack of automated fail-safe countdown interlocks on safety-critical overrides.
